Name: Catalogues Anywhere
Author: CherryChain
Description:
Lets you open the furniture and wallpaper/flooring catalogues from anywhere.


[b][size=5]Install[/size][/b]
[list=1]
[*][url=https://smapi.io]Install the latest version of SMAPI[/url].
[*]Unzip the mod folder into [font=Courier New]Stardew Valley/Mods[/font].
[*]Run the game using SMAPI.
[/list]
[b][size=5]How to use[/size][/b]
Press these key binds to open the catalogues in-game:
[list]
[*][font=Courier New]Left control + 1[/font]: wallpaper and flooring.
[*][font=Courier New]Left control + 2[/font]: base furniture.
[*][font=Courier New]Left control + 3[/font]: Joja furniture.
[*][font=Courier New]Left control + 4[/font]: Junimo furniture.
[*][font=Courier New]Left control + 5[/font]: Retro furniture.
[*][font=Courier New]Left control + 6[/font]: Trash furniture.
[*][font=Courier New]Left control + 7[/font]: Wizard furniture.
[/list]
You can use [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] to change these key binds (which includes adding controller bindings).


[b][size=5]Common questions[/size][/b]
[quote][size=3][b]Is the mod still compatible?[/b][/size]
The mod is compatible with Stardew Valley 1.6.15 or later on Linux/macOS/Windows, both single-player and multiplayer.[/quote][quote][size=3][b]Does the mod conflict with any others?[/b][/size]
There are no known mod conflicts. Feel free to report compatibility issues in the mod comments.[/quote][quote][size=3][b]Can I safely add/remove the mod anytime?[/b][/size]
Yep, the mod makes no changes to your save.[/quote]
